description.zh: 自定义属性值，key为自定义属性标识，value最多一个值；空列表表示删除该属性值。不传Description时传入本参数可避免清空字段业务描述；传空对象表示不更新自定义属性
description.en: The custom attributes of the column, specified as key-value pairs. The key is the attribute identifier, and the value is an array that can contain at most one element. An empty array deletes the attribute's value. To avoid overwriting the column's business description, omit the `Description` parameter from the request. An empty object (`{}`) indicates that no custom attributes are updated.
The business description of the column.

description.zh:
字段ID，可参考ListColumns接口返回结果，
以及[元数据实体相关概念说明](~~2880092~~)。
description.en: The ID of the column. You can obtain this ID from the response of the `ListColumns` operation. For more information, see [Metadata Entity Concepts](~~2880092~~).

title.zh: 更新数据地图数据表字段的业务元数据

descriptions.zh:
1. 需要购买DataWorks基础版及以上版本才能使用。
2. 仅maxcompute, hms, dlf 类型支持
descriptions.en:
1. This operation requires DataWorks Basic Edition or a later version.

2. This operation supports only MaxCompute, hms, and dlf tables.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dataworks-public update-column-business-metadata --id maxcompute-column:::project_name:_schema_name_:table_name:column_name --description test_description --custom-attributes '{"biz_owner":["张三"]}' --api-version 2024-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
